rawAnswer: {"findings":[{"kind":"defect","severity":"high","title":"MsgPack014 filter reversed from NotAnnotated to Annotated","detail":"In SymbolStartAction, the MsgPack014 (NullableReferenceTypeFormatter) query now selects IMessagePackFormatter<T> type arguments whose NullableAnnotation is Annotated, where it used to select NotAnnotated ones. So every formatter that already implements the annotated interface correctly now gets a warning telling it to do what it already does. Before the change it at least surfaced as an analyzer crash. The generator then goes on with neither an int nor a string key. The same applies to any other diagnostic whose location lookup returns null for a source type. Requirement item N1 says problems must not pass silently.
